Run Treasure Hunt/Prize Packages Silent Library/Reboot Community portal forum Katie Nolan Katie Nolan Name: Katherine Beth Nolan Born: January 28, 1987 Birth Hometown: Framingham, Massachusetts Occupation: Television hostRadio and Podcast hostComedianInternet personality Years active: 2011–present Known for: Crowd Goes WildNo Filter with Katie NolanTouchdown in IsraelGarbage Time with Katie NolanNFL Films PresentsThe Garbage Time Podcast with Katie NolanSportsCenter on SnapchatAlways Late w/ Katie NolanSports? with Katie Nolan (podcast)Casuals with Katie Nolan (podcast)Fan Service with Katie Nolan (talk radio) Katherine Beth Nolan (born January 28, 1987) is an American sports media personality and host. She currently hosts the sports talk radio show Fan Service with Katie Nolan and the podcast Casuals with Katie Nolan, both for SiriusXM Contents 1 Jeopardy! run 1.1 Celebrity Jeopardy! 2 Shows hosted 3 Shows appeared 4 YouTube Links 5 References Jeopardy! run[] Celebrity Jeopardy![] In the third quarterfinal game, she faced off against Christopher Meloni and Sherri Shepherd. Throughout the first three rounds, she came up with 36/41 correct questions (including 2/4 Daily Doubles). She and Christopher got Final correct; however, Katie wagered $3,500 to tie with Christopher. It was the first game to have five rounds. Katie got the tiebreaker correct to advance to the semifinals while Christopher and Sherri received $30,000 each for their charities. In the second semifinal game, she faced off against Steven Weber and Dulé Hill. Throughout the first three rounds, she came up with 34/35 correct questions (including 3/3 Daily Doubles). Nobody got Final Jeopardy! correct, but Katie was the only player who did not wager all her winnings and advanced to the finals while Steven and Dule received $50,000 each for their charities. In the finals, she faced off against Mo Rocca and Lisa Ann Walter. Throughout the first three rounds, she came up with 31/34 correct questions (2/2 Daily Doubles). She and Mo both got Final Jeopardy! incorrect, but after losing to Lisa Ann (in a come-from-behind win, winning $1,000,000 for her charity, the Celebrity Jeopardy! trophy, and a spot in the 2025 Jeopardy! Tournament of Champions[1]), she received $100,000 for her charity for finishing as the second runner-up while Mo (who led going into Final) received $250,000 for his charity for finishing as the first runner-up. In the first quarterfinal game, she faced off against Rachel Dratch and Mark Duplass. Throughout the first three rounds, she came up with 32/32 correct responses (including 1/1 Daily Double). She was the only player correct in Final and advanced to the semifinals. Mark and Rachel received $30,000 for their charities. Shows hosted[] I've Got a Secret (2023 pilot) Shows appeared[] Celebrity Jeopardy! YouTube Links[] In addition to her own podcast, Katie is a recurring guest on Pablo Torre Finds Out, a podcast hosted by her former ESPN colleague (who also won fast money on Celebrity Family Feud). Following the broadcast of each of her Celebrity Jeopardy! matches, Katie made a guest appearance to discuss her experience: Share & Tell: "Celebrity Jeopardy!" Winner Katie Nolan + Gasbags Dan Le Batard & Pablo Torre | PTFO Inside The "Jeopardy!" Gauntlet: Share & Tell With Katie Nolan, Dan Soder, And Pablo | PTFO The Doctor Is In: Katie Nolan And Dan Soder’s Final “Jeopardy!” Share & Tell | PTFO References[] ↑ Walter did not participate in the 2025 Jeopardy! Tournament of Champions due to taping Abbott Elementary (she was replaced by 2025 Jeopardy! Champions Wildcard first runner-up Drew Goins), but she returned to the 2026 Jeopardy!
